jira.description: Jira integration — read/write issues, link PRs to tickets, post status updates

github.description: GitHub integration — PRs, issues, code review comments, CI status

slack.description: Slack integration — post deployment notifications, incident alerts, PR review pings

datadog.description: Datadog integration — query metrics, fetch logs, inspect monitors and dashboards

postgres-readonly.description: Read-only Postgres access for schema inspection and query analysis. No writes.

rules: All server credentials must come from environment variables — no hardcoded values
Each server has 'trust: project' — available to all contributors on this repo
Personal/experimental servers belong in ~/.claude.json, not here
Adding a new server requires team review and update to docs/mcp-servers.md
Servers with write access (jira, github, slack) require explicit user confirmation before mutations
_governance.credential_expansion: Variables are expanded from the shell environment at session start. Use .env (gitignored) for local development. CI injects secrets via the secrets manager.
_governance.audit: All MCP tool invocations are logged to .claude/audit/mcp-calls.jsonl in development mode
